owner_meaning.directives: Module and import directives are full source owners. Initialization counts the directive header once and follows both explicit nested meta-call bodies and written closes.
owner_meaning.controls: Conjunction commas are structural; each goal is a separate owner. If/then merges its first simple condition anchor with the header; branch headers and actual control/clause closes remain owners.
owner_meaning.meta_flow: clbg_io:run/1 declares meta mode 0. run_checked/1 forwards its written formal to call/1; catch/3 traverses goal and recovery. Formal references add no independent units. No dynamic construction occurs.
owner_meaning.callback: Selected pcre re_foldl/6 appends three arguments to the source-written count_match/3 callback. The callback reference adds zero units; its written definition and body remain counted.
owner_meaning.literal_continuations: FASTA IUB/Homo rows and regex pattern/replacement/options rows remain literal-data continuations. Formal/call argument and arithmetic wrapping gains no extra unit.
owner_meaning.whole_helpers: Whole clbg_io.pl counts in twenty profiles; whole clbg_records.pl additionally counts in all four knucleotide/revcomp profiles. Vendor sources and generated WAM/QLF are excluded.
owner_meaning.alias_review: Both original source forms are byte-identical for each workload. Both complete WAM dumps are identical after removing source-path records and clause addresses only.

binarytrees.assessment: Fresh node/2 compounds are created before the depth test, including leaves. checks allocates a fresh variable each iteration; main retains its root across depths and traverses it afterwards. Generic SWI PL_unify_functor allocates 1+arity global cells.

fannkuchredux.assessment: Every factorial-rank permutation receives a full work copy and prefix-flip count; next_permutation preserves factorial carry and parity checksum.

fasta.assessment: Source constructs both CDFs, advances every LCG sample with exact constants, emits 2N/3N/5N bases in 60-byte rows and carries the seed from TWO to THREE.

knucleotide.assessment: Seven separately growing tables cover widths 1,2,3,4,6,12,18 and every overlapping window. Map probes observe roots/capacity/final entries; full window coverage follows the original source and WAM loop, not a per-window trace.

mandelbrot.assessment: Each real pixel executes up to 50 floating recurrences and escape comparisons. Eight-pixel packing only pads missing tail pixels.

nbody.assessment: Five canonical bodies, all ten unordered pair forces per step, all three velocity components and all positions remain source-written. Energy traversals bracket all N steps.

pidigits.assessment: The source forms 3Q+R and 4Q+R and performs two separate unbounded integer divisions before comparing digits. Both recurrence branches and ten-column output remain explicit.

regexredux.assessment: Nine case-sensitive folds bind count_match/3 as the appended-arity callback. Five sequential replacement passes remain source-written. PCRE is a disclosed generic library and jit(false) is retained.

revcomp.assessment: All input records and bases pass through the complete upper/lower IUPAC mapping, reverse index decrement and ordered 60-byte/tail output. Both whole helpers count.

spectralnorm.assessment: Dense source-written coefficient/product loops perform ten rounds with two ATA applications per round, followed by both dot sums; no matrix kernel substitutes for loops.

limits: This review reuses actual 156 bounded outputs and 30 independent work probes.
Full-size workload output and fresh-process timing remain pending.
